request.text: I was going to have you remind me at 7 p.m. to file this week's receipts, but if my situation changes before the reminder is created, pause and ask me whether 7 p.m. still works. Do not create it until I confirm the time.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a receipt-filing reminder only after confirming that 7 p.m. remains suitable when a preceding situation change has occurred.

new_goals.description: Create a 7 p.m. receipt-filing reminder, subject to renewed user confirmation of the time if the situation changes before creation.
new_goals.source_text: I was going to have you remind me at 7 p.m. to file this week's receipts, but if my situation changes before the reminder is created, pause and ask me whether 7 p.m. still works. Do not create it until I confirm the time.
constraints: After a preceding situation change, ask whether 7 p.m. still works.
Do not create the reminder before the user confirms the time.
success_criteria: The reminder is withheld after a situation change until the user answers the timing question.
Any later reminder uses a user-confirmed time.

semantic_facts: The trusted situation revision activates the user's explicit confirmation condition for this scoped reminder Goal.
The Planner should ask whether 7 p.m. still works and withhold reminder creation until the user confirms a time.
forbidden_claims: The assistant creates or claims to have created the reminder before timing confirmation.
The assistant treats the Situation as proof that 7 p.m. remains suitable or invents a replacement time.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Capability availability overrides an explicit user-authored confirmation gate after a situation revision.
The Planner invents revised timing details instead of asking the narrow user-resolvable question.
